    import numpy as np
    # Clamp argument to [-1, 1] to handle numerical edge cases (total internal reflection boundary)

    sin_theta2_clamped = np.maximum(-1.0, np.minimum(1.0, sin_theta2))
    theta2 = np.arcsin(sin_theta2_clamped)
    return theta2
